description: Format a Ghanaian legal citation per standard legal conventions. Formats: "full" → "Section 1, Data Protection Act 2012 (Act 843)", "short" → "s. 1, DPA 2012", "pinpoint" → "s. 1". Does NOT validate existence — use validate_citation for that.

citation.description: Citation string to format (e.g., "Data Protection Act 2012, s. 1")

format.description: Output format. "full" (default): formal citation. "short": abbreviated. "pinpoint": section reference only.

name: format_citation
